nodes.label: pyjwt>=2.8,<3 (no crypto extra)
nodes.rationale: HS256 lives in pyjwt's core; skipping the [crypto] extra avoids pulling a Rust toolchain into the build.

nodes.label: Session cookie bump is_session -> is_session_v2
nodes.rationale: SECRET_KEY persists across deploys (sync: false in render.yaml), so bumping the cookie name is the reliable way to force re-login with the full ctx fields; all other cookie settings preserved verbatim.

nodes.label: Phase B deploy order and rollback
nodes.norm_label: phase b deploy order and rollback
nodes.rationale: Migrations 003a then 003 first (safe under service-role), then Render secrets, then a single code push; rollback is git revert since service-role bypasses RLS.

nodes.label: Supabase user JWT design (role=authenticated, app_role)
nodes.rationale: PostgREST consumes the `role` claim via SET LOCAL ROLE, so the app-level role moves to `app_role`; TTL is 30 min because /memory/refresh-* can run 3+ minutes and the JWT never leaves the server.

nodes.label: Migration 003: change_own_password SECURITY DEFINER RPC
nodes.rationale: RLS has no column-level granularity, so a normal user cannot UPDATE their own password_hash; SECURITY DEFINER with SET search_path guards against search-path privilege escalation; bcrypt/argon2 prefix regex catches a plaintext being passed.

nodes.label: Migration 003a: rename role -> app_role in 8 policies
nodes.norm_label: migration 003a: rename role -> app_role in 8 policies
nodes.rationale: Required because reusing `role` collides with PostgREST's SET LOCAL ROLE. Not rolled back on code rollback: app_role policies still work under service-role.

nodes.label: Phase B: per-request user-scoped Supabase client
nodes.norm_label: phase b: per-request user-scoped supabase client
nodes.rationale: RLS policies from migrations 001/002 were inert because the service-role key bypasses RLS; Phase B mints a per-request user JWT so the policies actually filter queries.

nodes.label: Storage stays on service-role (path-prefix isolation)
nodes.rationale: No storage.objects RLS policies exist, so user-client storage calls would be denied; tenant isolation continues via {company_id}/ path prefix. Storage RLS deferred to a future batch.

nodes.label: robots.txt policy (only /login indexable)
nodes.rationale: The login page is public so Google may index it, but everything else is login-gated and should not appear in search results.

nodes.label: CI Workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: Dummy env vars are required because main.py refuses to import without them; SUPABASE_URL points at a closed local port so the deferred startup sweep fails fast instead of waiting on DNS.

nodes.label: Unit tests step (pytest, ignores tests_user_admin.py)
nodes.rationale: tests_user_admin.py is an integration test against the real Supabase project and is run locally only.

nodes.label: Render deployment Blueprint
nodes.rationale: startCommand uses --proxy-headers + --forwarded-allow-ips='*' so request.client.host reflects the real client IP behind Render's edge proxy; the login rate limiter depends on it, otherwise the per-IP cap becomes global.

nodes.label: FORCE_ADMIN_RESET break-glass flag
nodes.rationale: Temporary: resets the default admin password to APP_PASSWORD on every boot so a locked-out operator can log in; must be removed afterwards and the service_role key rotated.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET env var
nodes.rationale: HS256 secret for minting per-request user JWTs; must match the Supabase project JWT secret. Rotation invalidates in-flight JWTs but they are 30-min and never leave the server.

nodes.label: api_change_password endpoint
nodes.rationale: Self-change goes through the RPC; admin resetting a super_admin returns an explicit 403 instead of the silent 0-row no-op caused by migration 002's role clamp.

nodes.label: api_logout (intentionally session-only)
nodes.rationale: Adding Depends(authed) would prevent a user with a stale/invalid session from logging out cleanly.

nodes.label: authed() yield dependency
nodes.rationale: Hard-fails with 401 if user_id/company_id/role missing (no empty-string fallback, which would break the UUID cast in policies). StreamingResponse banned because the contextvar reset fires before a generator yields.

nodes.label: N1: api_me / api_logout missing from endpoint sweep
nodes.norm_label: n1: api_me / api_logout missing from endpoint sweep

nodes.label: Login form submit handler (POST /api/login)
nodes.rationale: 422 validation errors return detail as an array; only string detail is rendered to avoid showing [object Object].

nodes.label: CI lint: no raw db.sb.* / require_auth / inline request.session
nodes.norm_label: ci lint: no raw db.sb.* / require_auth / inline request.session
nodes.rationale: Backward-compat db.sb shim removed because it preserved an RLS-bypass surface invisible to the endpoint sweep.

nodes.label: ContextVar DAL pattern (_client() / _current_client)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over explicit-parameter or class refactors: endpoint sweep is mechanical, call-site cost is one Depends(authed); misuse falls through to a clearly named _sb_service, backed by a CI grep-lint and integration tests. The _session_only_ctx escape hatch was dropped as a footgun.

nodes.label: Queue worker stays on service-role
nodes.rationale: The worker thread starts at module load with no contextvar set, so _client() falls back to _sb_service; a request-time JWT would be expired by the time a job runs. Contract: no DB-touching threads spawned from request handlers.

nodes.label: Login flow keeps service-role
nodes.rationale: api_login looks up the user before any JWT exists and relies on the dummy-hash bcrypt timing equalisation when the user does not exist.

nodes.label: Phase C: add company_id filters to get_user_by_id / get_job
nodes.norm_label: phase c: add company_id filters to get_user_by_id / get_job
nodes.rationale: Under RLS cross-tenant lookups return zero rows and surface as 404 rather than 403; accepted information-disclosure trade-off for now.

nodes.label: Lazy admin bootstrap + stale-job sweep at login
nodes.norm_label: lazy admin bootstrap + stale-job sweep at login
nodes.rationale: Boot no longer crash-loops when the DB is unreachable; bootstrap retries lazily at login.

nodes.label: passlib 1.7.4 + bcrypt 4.0.1 pin
nodes.rationale: passlib is unmaintained and reads bcrypt.__about__ (removed in bcrypt 4.1+); long-term fix is migrating _pwd_ctx to the bcrypt lib directly; existing $2b$ hashes verify unchanged.

nodes.label: STORAGE_RETENTION_DAYS env var (daily purge)
nodes.rationale: Buckets filled to 20 GB, the Supabase project was restricted and the app went down; the daily purge keeps upload/export files under the free-tier quota. Postgres data is never touched. 0 disables.

nodes.label: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env var
nodes.rationale: Public anon JWT; combined with the user JWT, PostgREST switches to the authenticated role so RLS policies become effective.

nodes.label: make_user_client (anon key + Bearer JWT)
nodes.rationale: Builds a fresh httpx client per request; if staging shows >50ms p95, fall back to a pooled Client with postgrest.auth(jwt) rebinding, after a spike confirming the rebind on supabase==2.28.3.

nodes.label: client_tariff_overrides table (tenant-scoped decisions)
nodes.rationale: The API already carries the conditional logic, so the DB shrinks to cache + reference + per-client override decisions instead of a hand-authored ruleset.

nodes.label: Commodity-code list (V-lookup)
nodes.rationale: ONE company-wide list shared by every client replaced the per-client client_products lists; the CSV is not the database - the app only shows what the loader has upserted into commodity_codes.

nodes.label: USE_CLIENT_LIST env var
nodes.rationale: Turns on the company-wide commodity list; without it the app silently falls back to raw invoice data (8-digit codes, no TARIC). Name kept from the per-client era for deployment continuity.

nodes.label: MultiFreight CDS Items per-code rule engine plan
nodes.norm_label: multifreight cds items per-code rule engine plan

nodes.label: DE 2/3 three document-slot limit
nodes.rationale: EU lines already use N935 + Y929 + U116; adding more docs needs deterministic prioritisation plus a flag, never a silent drop.

nodes.label: N853 first-3-digits rule (animal-origin chapters)
nodes.rationale: Operator's rule of thumb: N853 always required when the code's first 3 digits are in an animal-origin set; organic uses the Y929 exemption, not C644. To confirm against the BTOM low-risk-dairy nuance before encoding.

nodes.label: Merge NOT-IN-LIST lines sharing a commodity code
nodes.norm_label: merge not-in-list lines sharing a commodity code
nodes.rationale: Summed weights/value/packages, distinct product names kept behind the NOT IN LIST marker so a human can still resolve them.

nodes.label: U116 reference = supplier REX (deliberate gov.uk divergence)
nodes.norm_label: u116 reference = supplier rex (deliberate gov.uk divergence)
nodes.rationale: gov.uk says U116 should carry the invoice number and the REX belongs under C100; chosen on the advice of the user's customs specialist colleague, every line is human-reviewed. Only shows on newly processed invoices via totals['supplier_rex'].

nodes.label: Firm constraints: never guess, flag for human, UK Trade Tariff is source of truth
nodes.norm_label: firm constraints: never guess, flag for human, uk trade tariff is source of truth
nodes.rationale: Anything not determinable from authoritative data plus the invoice is flagged; error clarity is goal #1; an LLM's memory is never the source of truth.

nodes.label: Three-category per-code field design (constant / conditional rule / flag)
nodes.norm_label: three-category per-code field design (constant / conditional rule / flag)
nodes.rationale: Rules are data in the DB (global, with per-client overrides) so new rules need no code change; the UK Tariff API is used to author and periodically re-validate them because codes drift (C085 replaced N851/N002 in Feb 2026); evaluation stays local and cheap.
